questions.q_en: How long does company incorporation take?
questions.q_zh: 公司註冊需要多長時間？
questions.a_en: Most incorporations are completed within 1–3 business days once all documents are submitted. For foreign directors, additional approvals may extend the timeline to 5–7 business days.
questions.a_zh: 大多數註冊在提交所有文件後 1–3 個工作天內完成。對於外國董事，額外的審批可能需要 5–7 個工作天。

questions.q_en: What documents do I need for incorporation?
questions.q_zh: 公司註冊需要哪些文件？
questions.a_en: You will need a valid identification document, proof of residential address, and your proposed company name. For foreign directors, passport copies and additional details are required.
questions.a_zh: 您需要有效的身份證明文件、住址證明以及擬用的公司名稱。外國董事則需提供護照副本及其他詳細資料。

questions.q_en: Do I need to be physically present to register a company?
questions.q_zh: 我需要親身到場才能註冊公司嗎？
questions.a_en: No. The entire process can be completed remotely. We handle all filings electronically and can arrange nominee director services if required.
questions.a_zh: 不需要。整個流程可以遠程完成。我們以電子方式處理所有申報，並可安排提名董事服務（如有需要）。

questions.q_en: What is a nominee director and do I need one?
questions.q_zh: 什麼是提名董事？我需要嗎？
questions.a_en: A nominee director is a locally resident individual appointed to meet statutory requirements. Foreign-owned companies typically require a nominee director to comply with local regulations.
questions.a_zh: 提名董事是為符合法定要求而委任的當地居民個人。外資公司通常需要提名董事以遵守當地法規。

questions.q_en: How does the accounting service work?
questions.a_en: We connect your accounts to our cloud-based platform. Your dedicated accountant categorizes transactions monthly, prepares financial statements, and handles all tax filings on schedule.
questions.a_zh: 我們將您的賬戶連接到雲端平台。您的專屬會計師每月進行交易分類、準備財務報表，並按時處理所有稅務申報。

questions.a_en: Yes. We offer a 30-day money-back guarantee on all our plans. If you are not satisfied within the first 30 days, we will refund your payment in full.
questions.a_zh: 有。我們為所有方案提供 30 天退款保證。如果您在首 30 天內不滿意，我們將全額退款。

questions.q_en: Can I switch plans as my business grows?
questions.q_zh: 隨著業務成長，我可以轉換方案嗎？
questions.a_en: Absolutely. You can upgrade or downgrade your plan at any time. We will prorate the difference and ensure a smooth transition with no disruption to your services.
questions.a_zh: 當然可以。您可以隨時升級或降級方案。我們將按比例計算差額，並確保順利過渡，服務不受中斷。

questions.q_en: How do you protect my data?
questions.q_zh: 你們如何保護我的資料？
questions.a_en: We employ bank-grade encryption, multi-factor authentication, and strict access controls. Our systems undergo regular independent security audits to ensure your information stays protected.
questions.a_zh: 我們採用銀行級別加密、多因素認證及嚴格的存取控制。我們的系統定期接受獨立安全審計，確保您的資訊受到保護。
